directAnswer: DLSS can enhance image quality by using AI to upscale lower resolution images, resulting in sharper visuals without a significant performance hit.
summary: DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) leverages AI to improve image quality in supported games by rendering at a lower resolution and upscaling it intelligently.

sections.heading: How DLSS Works
sections.body: DLSS uses deep learning algorithms to analyze and upscale images. It renders frames at a lower resolution and then applies AI to fill in the details, making the final output look closer to native resolution.

sections.heading: Supported Games
sections.body: Not all games support DLSS. Check the specific game settings or the official game website to see if DLSS is available.

sections.heading: Performance vs. Quality
sections.body: While DLSS improves image quality, the effectiveness can vary between titles. Some games may show noticeable improvements, while others may not.

steps.title: Enable DLSS in Game Settings
steps.detail: Go to the graphics settings menu of your game. Look for the DLSS option and set it to 'On' or choose a specific quality mode (Performance, Balanced, or Quality).

steps.title: Update Graphics Drivers
steps.detail: Ensure your GPU drivers are up to date. Visit the NVIDIA website or use GeForce Experience to download the latest drivers that support DLSS.

steps.title: Select the Right Resolution
steps.detail: For optimal results, select a resolution that is lower than your monitor's native resolution when using DLSS, as it is designed to upscale from a lower base.

faqs.question: Does DLSS work on all NVIDIA GPUs?
faqs.answer: DLSS is primarily supported on NVIDIA RTX series GPUs that have Tensor Cores. Older GTX series GPUs do not support DLSS.

faqs.question: Can DLSS cause visual artifacts?
faqs.answer: In some cases, DLSS may introduce visual artifacts or blurriness, particularly in fast-moving scenes or specific game environments.

faqs.question: Is DLSS available on consoles?
faqs.answer: Yes, DLSS is available on some next-gen consoles like the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, but implementation may vary by game.

caveats: DLSS performance can vary significantly between different games and settings, and not all users may notice a substantial improvement.
